subject.title: fix(ci): accept valid Kova PASS records without violations

question: Should OpenClaw accept this narrow Kova report-gate tolerance for PASS records that omit `violations` once the draft branch has current merge-head proof?
rationale: The patch is correct and dependency-backed, but it intentionally changes the trusted release-gate adapter's success decision and the PR is maintainer-labeled and draft, so automation should not make the final release-automation policy call.

options.title: Accept After Current-Head Proof
options.body: Refresh or prove the exact merge head, then merge if omitted PASS violations are accepted and malformed, hidden, and failed-record cases still reject.

options.title: Require Stronger Kova Contract Proof
options.body: Ask for direct captured-report or Kova schema/source proof in the PR before accepting the helper tolerance.

options.title: Keep The Gate Strict
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want Kova to always emit `violations: []` instead of accepting omitted PASS fields in OpenClaw's adapter.

recommendation.title: Accept After Current-Head Proof
recommendation.body: Refresh or prove the exact merge head, then merge if omitted PASS violations are accepted and malformed, hidden, and failed-record cases still reject.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the recent Kova report-gate helper history and authored the merged predecessor on this exact adapter path.
